answer:
Soybean suits this field well, achieving a suitability score of 92 out of 100 based on Astrovivu suitability score computed from the readings of the field on 2026-11-14 [S1]. The field is reliable for soybean in 14 of 20 analysed years [S1].

The limiting factor for soybean in this field is temperature in the growing window (scored 92 out of 100, with an actual temperature of 19.2 °C against an ideal of 20-33 °C for the worst month of the 4-month window) [S1]. Temperature is a fixed factor that cannot be changed [S1].

Manageable factors like water, soil pH, texture, drainage, salinity, and fertility all score 100 out of 100 [S1]. Water over the growing window is 604 mm (414 mm of rain plus 190 mm of stored soil water), meeting the ideal 600-1500 mm range [S2][S1]. The soil pH is 6.2, sitting comfortably in the optimal 5.5-6.5 range [S2][S1]. The soil texture is medium (loam) [S1], and drainage is well-drained [S1].

Check for soybean cyst nematode and other local pests before planting, as they are common challenges for soybeans in the region [S3].
